caption_link.limitation: The source provides matching numeric IDs only. It does not provide an original post URL, date, media link, or an explicit asset-to-caption key.

inspection.evidence_scope: Source-bound start, material-intermediate, and near-complete frames were extracted from the original local GIF and visually inspected; metadata came from that same source file.

motion_sampling.method: Three source-bound frame samples extracted from the original local GIF for review; no derivative was added to the corpus.
motion_sampling.limitation: Three sampled frames establish the observed state change, not a frame-by-frame reconstruction of timing or platform playback.

visual_anatomy.title: A large offer-design promise leaves most words in a light sans but turns the easy-to-sell qualifier into two oversized lavender rough-display tags.
visual_anatomy.layout: A central tapered comparison field is split into four stacked layers—problem, results, buying, and delivery—with horizontal left/right trade-off arrows, a simple easy-to-hard polarity at the top, and three example cards at the bottom.
visual_anatomy.reading_order: Promise → easy-versus-hard polarity → read the central layers bottom-to-top while comparing the left and right ends of each arrow → example offer cards.
visual_anatomy.typography: Very large lightweight headline, hand-rendered emphasis inside rounded tags, bold layer labels, and compact paired criteria aligned to arrow lines.
visual_anatomy.colour: Lavender dominates the promise and delivery layer; pink, aqua, and pale blue separate the remaining layers; the hard side is a deep desaturated purple.
visual_anatomy.surface: White page, a fine dark rounded outer frame, thin horizontal arrows, translucent gradient-filled trapezoid, raised rounded labels, and diffuse grey shadows.
visual_anatomy.modules: One polarity scale, four decision layers crossed with paired trade-offs, and three concrete example cards.
visual_anatomy.density: High but directional: each horizontal line supplies one contrast and the tapered hierarchy gives the reader a reliable vertical route.

motion.observed_state_change: Sampled states preserve the full offer-comparison structure while black and white markers travel along opposing horizontal arrows and the bottom example pointer changes its target; the completed frame returns to the same readable reference.
motion.motion_job: Make the static trade-offs feel like positions on an easy-to-hard continuum without making the reader infer a different underlying model.
motion.limitation: Three sampled frames establish the observed state change, not a frame-by-frame reconstruction of timing or platform playback.

transferable_mechanism.reader_job: Assess why one offer is easier or harder to buy by seeing several interdependent trade-offs together.
transferable_mechanism.mechanism: Put a bounded set of causal or decision-relevant dimensions on shared two-ended lines, then group those dimensions into the stages where the reader can act on them.
transferable_mechanism.use_condition: Use only when both ends of every continuum are meaningful, non-overlapping, and based on a defensible operating distinction rather than decorative opposites.

anti_copy_boundary: Do not reuse the offer framework, easy/hard claims, tapered four-layer geometry, example statements, arrow-marker motion, rough title tags, colour sequence, or label treatment.

claim_boundary.note: The asset makes comparative statements about selling difficulty and examples. Its caption is paired only by numeric ID and no underlying evidence is supplied.
